author: naascott
text:
Haven't posted in a while, but I liked what I was seeing on the E/U

A quick look at the daily, and price is calling me to an FTR

Then, I jump down to LTF's and start looking for smaller FTR's and where price might want to show signs of reversal. I see a nice CP zone, a nice RN, then two smaller FTR's just above the RN. I then see what appears to be a small poke into the CP zone. Now it's getting interesting.

I think these type of set ups can be traded time and again with amazing accuracy.

Here is a little set of management rules that can be used in doing so:

1. If you see an approach to a daily FTR. 2. Mark off any clear compression zone as price approaches the FTR. 3. Locate all fresh, non tested FTR'S on lower time frame (5 min 1 min). Look for big RN's near area. 4. If you have two FTR's on the lower time frame in close proximity of the RN, place entry at RN and stop above no more than two FTR's. PIP risk could be 10-20 pips max or whatever % your account will allow. 5 Target other side of CP zone.

Great RVR!
